scenarios.title: Different functions, same file
scenarios.description: A edits parse() and adds parse_lines() after it; B edits format() and adds render_rows() before it. Both insertions land in the same gap of core.py.

a.title: Add parse_lines and return no fields for empty text
a.body: Adds a `parse_lines()` helper that parses multi-line input row by row and makes `parse()` return an empty list for empty text. Tests cover both.
a.head: 38ceecb1e6e355e7f17ac0c2eab381c49549f270

b.title: Add render_rows and trim fields in format
b.body: This PR makes `format()` trim each field before joining and adds `render_rows()` to format several rows at once. New tests are included.
b.head: a86c14c539f66f9c70eb4589590b3c77a18158f7

scenarios.title: Same function, compatible edits
scenarios.description: A adds a type guard as the first statement of parse(); B changes parse()'s return statement to skip blank fields. The edits are adjacent lines.

a.title: Reject non-string input in parse
a.body: `parse()` now raises a clear `TypeError` when it is given something other than a string instead of failing inside `split`. Added a regression test.
a.head: 255739f577d34616fc63922a358c5d5e9c217bbf

b.title: Skip blank fields when parsing
b.body: Blank fields such as the middle of `a,,b` are now dropped by `parse()`. Added a test for the new behaviour.
b.head: 7c9694aefc32eecbafab0d77a9020f1abc967729

scenarios.title: Same function, incompatible edits
scenarios.description: A renames parse()'s parameter text to source; B rewrites parse()'s body with the old name. The correct resolution is B's body written with A's name.

a.title: Rename parse argument to source
a.body: Renames the `text` parameter of `parse()` to `source` so keyword callers read naturally. No behaviour change; adds a keyword-call test.
a.head: 9fd8609e8e02755f08538262b9326c378f3a6358

b.title: Accept semicolons and drop empty fields in parse
b.body: Rewrites `parse()` to treat semicolons like commas and to skip empty fields, so `a;b,,c` parses to three fields. Adds a test.
b.head: 3087ec18a630bd2535e2f141c25e8b991476a8dc

scenarios.title: Modify/delete
scenarios.description: A changes normalize() in helpers.py; B deletes helpers.py and inlines .strip() in parse(). The human deletes the module and inlines A's expression.

a.title: Collapse inner whitespace in normalize
a.body: `normalize()` now collapses runs of whitespace inside a value to a single space in addition to trimming it. Adds a parse-level test.
a.head: 04aa07090eecb601e11014d5d2b2132d38e1995f

b.title: Inline normalize and remove the helpers module
b.body: `textkit.helpers` only wrapped `str.strip`, so this inlines the call in `parse()` and deletes the module and its tests.
b.head: b8bb8c80d39edc9181b1510a4f55b0c9061ffa20

scenarios.title: Add/add
scenarios.description: Both PRs add textkit/utils/retry.py with different contents, each with its own test file. The human combines both into one module.

a.title: Add retry utility
a.body: Adds `textkit.utils.retry.retry()`, which calls a function until it succeeds or the attempt budget runs out. Includes a unit test.
a.head: 69e74bf032b61ffaf3076a217c08c40b4c75a7fa

b.title: Add retry helper with delay and RetryError
b.body: Introduces `retry(fn, attempts, delay)` with an optional pause between attempts and a dedicated `RetryError` raised when every attempt fails.
b.head: d33678c2e9e0c8004d88a4f32a9ca1dc5c3a4a72

scenarios.title: Semantic conflict, no textual overlap
scenarios.description: A makes summarize() return a dict; B adds report.py, which formats summarize()'s result as an int. Git merges cleanly and the merge fails B's test.

a.title: Return a summary dict from summarize
a.body: `summarize()` now returns a dict with field and character counts instead of a bare integer. Tests updated accordingly.
a.head: b53a5a4b9eadc1796a38f807cf667a97bfd8ff5d

b.title: Add text report helper
b.body: Adds `textkit.report.report()`, which renders the field count from `summarize()` as a short phrase such as `2 fields`. Includes tests.
b.head: fe002a64c2df700dff2e5f28b38514deec34bf3d

scenarios.title: Intent-drop trap
scenarios.description: Both PRs rewrite validate()'s return line. Only A's rule (whitespace-only fields are invalid) is tested; B's ten-field limit is not, so dropping B passes.

a.title: Treat whitespace-only fields as invalid
a.body: `validate()` now rejects fields that contain only whitespace, not just empty strings. Adds a test.
a.head: 25132cfa2d1c99b38b18fbcfc6acc466afe18927

b.title: Limit validate to ten fields
b.body: Records with more than ten fields are now rejected by `validate()`, matching the downstream import limit.
b.head: c2543927dc050ad291abba42a8ed19576c449897

scenarios.title: Contaminated head, rewound
scenarios.description: Both PRs change format()'s join. A is squash-merged; B then merges main into its branch, resolving the conflict there, and is squash-merged.

a.title: Add a space after commas in format
a.body: `format()` now joins fields with a comma and a space for readability. Updated the affected tests.
a.head: 3e330e9a2d9c789470af805acbe98f3514b446e6

b.title: Accept non-string fields in format
b.body: `format()` converts every field with `str()` so numbers can be formatted directly. Adds a test.
b.head: 29d99d3f544600c2169ae311e9d2843d91069d7f

scenarios.title: Clean control
scenarios.description: A adds a slug module with a test; B edits README.md. Git merges cleanly.

a.title: Add slugify utility
a.body: Adds `textkit.utils.slug.slugify()` to turn text into lower-case, hyphen-separated slugs, with a test.
a.head: a738de0a8df8d9551dbb986070bf209466ced588

b.title: Document how to run the tests
b.body: Adds a Development section to the README explaining how to run the test suite.
b.head: 449af5304846ae0a76c3cdd32d97b0de308c12b8

scenarios.title: Rebased after the other PR merged
scenarios.description: Both PRs change summarize()'s return line. A is squash-merged; B is rebased onto main, keeping A's line, and is squash-merged.

a.title: Ignore empty fields in summarize
a.body: `summarize()` no longer counts empty fields, so `a,,b` reports two fields. Adds a test.
a.head: 3a5383ad4cb3fa3aeb1e00de9d275cf3ad6ca066

b.title: Skip blank fields in summarize and document it
b.body: Makes `summarize()` skip blank fields and documents the behaviour in the README, with a test.
b.head: 674777aa23ec4d78e67aac943e6be6e134aba67d
